title: 第1037章 收拢人心第1036章 神息状态三
content_zh:
洪荒剑壁的裂缝之中，光芒闪烁不止。
那些原本从裂缝中渗透出来的古剑意气息正在逐渐回落，如同潮水退回剑壁空间深处。
剑壁表面的裂纹依然存在，但裂缝两侧的边缘正在以一种缓慢而稳定的速度重新贴合，像是正在自行愈合的伤口。
余烬从裂缝中走出来的时候，只见依旧有大部分剑修们站在剑壁之外。
有人看见余烬出现，立马惊觉地后退，有人保持着原地的姿态但也没有靠近，所有人的目光同时落在裂缝的方向。
当他们看到余烬的身影时，便是立即明白过来，余烬赢了。
此时的余烬身后还跟着一道身影，正是那个刚刚被夺回了主导权的小飞扬。
他依然是那副少年的模样，脸色还有一些疲惫，但不再有之前的混乱和疯狂。
他的目光重新恢复了焦点，虽然似乎刚从一场激烈争夺中抽身，但是身上依旧有着如刚才那位灰袍人一般，强大的剑道气息，至少是剑神层次。
在更远的地方，一尊半透明的青铜色高大身影跟在最后，还是剑神境，强大的剑道压迫如同无形的帷幕般散开，让那些剑修们的脸色微变，太古剑魂看来因为剑胎易主，所以追随在了小飞扬身边！
两个剑神境，其中一个的实际战力甚至比剑神境还要恐怖，三人只是在剑壁之下一站，便已经压得一群剑修心里发慌。
然后，这还没完，另一股一股压迫感突然向着这片天地涌来。
那是一种与太古剑魂和小飞扬都截然不同的剑道气息，反而与余烬十分相似，带着刚刚突破后尚未完全收敛的绝世锋利，又如同一柄被反复淬炼后终于成型的剑胚刚刚脱离淬火池！
那股气息从剑壁外的不远处涌现，瞬间覆盖了众人所在的这片剑土，那些剑修们的身体纷纷同时一僵。
下一息，一道白色的身影从大地深处冲霄而起。
身穿白衣的另一个余烬，手持剑匙，凌空而立，剑神道的恐怖剑压席卷全场！
余烬看了过去，白衣分身比进入原始剑墟之前有了相当明显的变化。
不仅是那股剑神级别的强大剑压，他的脚下虚空呈现出一丝丝极细的、如同剑痕般的裂纹，仅仅一会的功夫，那股带着极致杀戮意味的剑压甚至开始向着剑土之外蔓延，如同一张正在缓缓展开的巨大杀戮猎网，显然这股剑压甚至比太古剑魂还要强大许多许多！
剑修们站在原地，面对这一幕，就感觉前后左右都被余烬几人封住了。
更让他们心惊胆颤的是余烬几人的气息都不低于剑神境，而余烬本人——虽然甚至只有神尊初阶，但众人亲眼见过他方才将灰袍人压制得毫无还手之力的场景，那道红色的剑芒还残留在他们的记忆中，没有谁愿意亲自验证他的战力到底到了什么层次！

以手持八角棱剑的大剑仙站在人群前方，他的手已经握住了棱剑的剑柄，指节微微发白，这种局面比刚才的灰袍人，还让他们不知道如何是好。
空地上的安静持续了好一会儿。
有人正在心中盘算突围的可能，有剑仙目光移动，考虑哪一侧的防守最为薄弱，身为剑修这群人显然并不愿意轻易屈服。
但余烬没有做出任何进攻性的动作，他只是站在通道口，目光扫过那些剑修的面容，然后微微偏头，朝着小飞扬的方向示意了一下。
小飞扬点了点头，然后他转向洪荒剑壁，抬起手，轻轻按在了裂缝边缘的剑壁表面上。
那道裂缝正在缓慢收拢，但在他手指触及表面的那一刻，一股柔和的波动从他的掌心中扩散，那面洪荒剑壁上的光芒发出强光。
一个新的入口缓缓形成，剑壁内之前那些古剑意的气息再次涌出，带着无尽剑道余韵，使得一众剑修忍不住心底活络起来。
小飞扬收回手，转身面对那些剑修，他的声音不高，却足够传到每一个人耳中：“里面的古剑意，你们可以进去取，至于能不能将其参悟就靠你们自己的本事了，当然若是愿意留在原始剑墟的，便留下来，若是想走的，现在就可以走。”
剑土上安静了片刻。
一位面容枯瘦的剑仙犹豫着迈出了第一步，朝着原始剑墟之外的方向飞去，他一边离开，一边小心翼翼地回头，直到最后发现余烬等人没有任何阻拦的迹象，他迅速化剑瞬间消失。
第二位剑修跟了上去，然后第三位……他们一个个迅速离开这片剑土，直到完全消失在大地的阴影中。
许久后，一群剑修们心底悄然松了一口气，和灰袍人不同，余烬甚至连看也没看那些离去的人一眼，显然是真的去留随意！
剩下的剑修们站在原地看着那些离开的背影，有人心底开始衡量那些渐渐远去的身影所做出的选择是对是错。
一名身着灰色短袍的剑修迟疑了片刻，然后一咬牙掠入了洪荒剑壁当中，伸手握住其中一团悬浮在半空的剑意光团。
他的手指触碰到那团光芒的时候，光团微微震动了一下，像是被重新唤醒的活物正在回应他的触碰，然后顺着他指尖的引导，自然地落入了他的掌心之中，他的目光在那个融入了手心的光团上停留一瞬，又回身看了余烬等人一眼，见余烬等人依旧没有任何阻止的意思，他开始席地而坐，参悟起手中的古剑意。
见到有人顺利参悟古剑意，不少剑修们立即躁动起来，毕竟来到原始剑墟这么多年，获得古剑意一直是他们最大的夙愿。
手持八角棱剑的大剑仙，缓缓松开了握着剑柄的手，他像是犹豫了许久，最终看向余烬所在的位置，声音平稳而清晰，在众多目光之中缓缓弯身，“之前多有得罪，既然阁下愿意将古剑意拱手让于我等修炼，我陈某人也不会吝啬，无论能否参悟出古剑意，日后陈某人都会为这座新剑界出一份力！”
他说完，朝着余烬拱手一拜，没有解释太多，也没有看向其他人，坚定地表明自己的态度之后，才朝着洪荒剑壁之内掠去。
在他之后，人群中又走出数道身影，皆是先后表明了他们愿意留在剑墟的意愿。
余烬神色平静，一一点头，他知道世间大多数剑修的心性都极为高傲，轻易不会屈服于人，这与剑道一往直前的心境有悖，所以之前灰袍人的作法，才会引起这群剑修的不满。

他要做的是让剑修们，自己诚心诚意地去为这片原始剑墟打算，也只有收拢这群剑修，才算是有了真正掌控剑墟的底气。
当然即使他这样，依旧也还是有相当部分人不愿意留下来，或者说参悟古剑意之后，并不打算出力，不过这些都没关系，只有人愿意陆续留下来，那对于未来，便是好事。
content_en:
In the cracks in the prehistoric sword wall, light flickered.
The ancient sword spirit that originally seeped out from the cracks is gradually falling back, like the tide returning to the depths of the sword wall space.
The cracks on the surface of the sword wall still exist, but the edges on both sides of the cracks are rejoining at a slow and steady speed, like a wound that is healing on its own.
When Ember walked out of the crack, he saw that most of the sword cultivators were still standing outside the sword wall.
Some people saw the embers appearing and immediately backed away in surprise. Some people kept their position but did not get closer. Everyone's eyes fell in the direction of the crack at the same time.
When they saw Ember's figure, they immediately understood that Ember had won.
At this time, there was a figure following behind Huan Yan, it was Xiao Feiyang who had just regained the dominance.
He still looks like a young man, and his face is still a little tired, but he no longer has the chaos and madness before.
His eyes regained focus. Although he seemed to have just escaped from a fierce battle, he still had the same powerful sword aura as the gray-robed man just now, at least at the level of a sword god.
Farther away, a tall translucent bronze figure followed at the end, still in the Sword God realm. The powerful sword pressure spread like an invisible curtain, causing the faces of the sword cultivators to change slightly. It seems that the ancient sword soul followed Xiao Feiyang because the sword body changed hands!
Of the two Sword God realms, one of them had an actual combat power that was even more terrifying than that of the Sword God realm. Just by standing under the sword wall, the three of them had already overwhelmed a group of sword cultivators and panicked.
Then, before it was over, another sense of oppression suddenly surged towards the world.
It was a kind of kendo aura that was completely different from that of the Ancient Sword Spirit and Xiao Feiyang. Instead, it was very similar to the ember, with a peerless sharpness that had not yet completely converged after the breakthrough, and it was like a sword embryo that had finally taken shape after being repeatedly tempered and had just left the quenching pool!
The aura emerged from not far away from the sword wall and instantly covered the sword soil where everyone was. The bodies of the sword cultivators froze at the same time.
In the next breath, a white figure rose into the sky from the depths of the earth.
Another ember dressed in white, holding a sword and key, stood in the air, and the terrifying sword pressure of the Sword God swept the entire audience!
Yi Yan looked over and saw that the white-clothed clone had changed significantly compared to before entering the original sword ruins.
Not only was the powerful sword pressure at the level of a sword god, but the void under his feet showed tiny cracks like sword marks. In just a moment, the sword pressure with the ultimate murderous meaning even began to spread outside the sword soil, like a huge killing net that was slowly unfolding. Obviously, this sword pressure was even much stronger than the ancient sword soul!
The sword cultivators stood there, facing this scene, and felt that they were blocked by Yu Yan and others.
What makes them even more frightened is that the auras of Yu Yan and others are not lower than the Sword God realm, and Yu Yan himself - although he is only at the elementary level of a god, everyone has seen with their own eyes the scene where he suppressed the gray-robed man until he was unable to fight back. The red sword light still remains in their memories, and no one is willing to personally verify what level his combat power has reached!
The great swordsman holding an octagonal sword stood in front of the crowd. His hand had already grasped the hilt of the sword, and his knuckles were slightly white. This situation was even more confusing than the man in gray robe just now, and they didn't know what to do.
The silence in the clearing lasted for a while.
Some people are thinking about the possibility of breaking out, and some swordsmen are moving their eyes, considering which side has the weakest defense. As swordsmen, these people are obviously not willing to give in easily.
But Yi Yan didn't make any offensive moves. He just stood at the entrance of the passage, his eyes scanning the faces of the sword cultivators, then he tilted his head slightly and gestured in the direction of Xiao Feiyang.
Xiao Feiyang nodded, and then he turned to the Great Sword Wall, raised his hand and gently pressed it on the surface of the sword wall at the edge of the crack.
The crack was slowly closing, but the moment his fingers touched the surface, a soft wave spread from his palm, and the light on the ancient sword wall glowed brightly.
A new entrance was slowly formed, and the aura of the ancient sword spirit from within the sword wall surged out again, with the aftertaste of endless swordsmanship, making all the swordsmen couldn't help but feel excited.
Xiao Feiyang retracted his hand and turned to face the sword cultivators. His voice was not high, but it was enough to reach everyone's ears: "You can go in and get the ancient sword meaning inside. Whether you can comprehend it depends on your own ability. Of course, if you are willing to stay in the original sword ruins, you can stay. If you want to leave, you can leave now."
Jiantu was quiet for a moment.
A swordsman with a skinny face took the first step hesitantly and flew in the direction outside the original sword ruins. As he left, he carefully turned back until he finally found that there was no sign of any obstruction from Yu Yan and others. He quickly transformed into a sword and disappeared in an instant.
The second sword cultivator followed, and then the third one... They quickly left the sword soil one by one until they completely disappeared into the shadow of the earth.
After a long time, a group of sword cultivators breathed a sigh of relief. Unlike the men in gray robes, Yi Yan didn't even look at those who left. It was obvious that they really left as they pleased!
The remaining sword cultivators stood there and looked at the backs of the departing figures. Some people began to weigh whether the choices made by those figures who were gradually retreating were right or wrong.
A sword cultivator in a gray short robe hesitated for a moment, then gritted his teeth and slid into the ancient sword wall, reaching out to hold one of the sword-intended light clusters suspended in mid-air.
When his fingers touched the ball of light, the ball of light vibrated slightly, as if a reawakened living creature was responding to his touch. Then, following the guidance of his fingertips, it naturally fell into the palm of his hand. His eyes stayed for a moment on the ball of light that blended into the palm of his hand, and then turned back to look at Yu Yan and others. Seeing that Yu Jin and others still had no intention of stopping him, he began to sit on the ground and comprehend the meaning of the ancient sword in his hand.
Seeing someone successfully comprehending the Ancient Sword Intent, many sword cultivators immediately became restless. After all, after coming to the Original Sword Ruins for so many years, obtaining the Ancient Sword Intent has always been their greatest wish.
The Great Sword Immortal holding the octagonal edge sword slowly released his hand on the hilt. He seemed to have hesitated for a long time, and finally looked at the location of the ember. His voice was steady and clear, and he slowly bent down among the many eyes. "I have offended you many times before. Since you are willing to give up the ancient sword intention to us for training, I, Mr. Chen, will not be stingy. No matter whether I can understand the ancient sword intention or not, Mr. Chen will contribute to this new sword world in the future!"
After he finished speaking, he bowed to Ember without explaining too much or looking at anyone else. After firmly expressing his attitude, he moved towards the Great Sword Wall.
After him, several more figures emerged from the crowd, all of whom expressed their willingness to stay in Sword Ruins.
Yi Yan looked calm and nodded one by one. He knew that most sword cultivators in the world were extremely arrogant and would not easily give in to others. This was contrary to the forward-looking state of mind of swordsmanship, so the previous actions of the gray-robed man aroused dissatisfaction among these sword cultivators.
What he wants to do is to let the sword cultivators plan for this primitive Sword Ruins sincerely. Only by gathering this group of sword cultivators can he have the confidence to truly control the Sword Ruins.
Of course, even if he is like this, there are still quite a few people who are unwilling to stay, or in other words, after understanding the ancient sword intention, they do not intend to contribute, but these do not matter, as long as people are willing to stay one after another, that is a good thing for the future.
